title: Wearable data analysis in 35 minutes
text: Analyzes more than 450 wearable-device data files from 30 people in 35 minutes, a job estimated at three weeks for a human expert.

title: Embryonic cell regulatory analysis
text: Analyzes data from over 336,000 human embryonic cells, confirms known regulatory relationships, and identifies new candidate transcription factors.

title: Candidate genes for a cilia screen
text: Navigates a map of molecular relationships to propose genes for a primary cilia screen, tested against human experts' spreadsheet-based guesses.

title: Cosmology solver built in days
text: Builds a differentiable cosmological Boltzmann solver in JAX over several days, tested against the reference CLASS code, reaching sub-percent agreement on CMB power spectra.

title: Sudakov shoulder calculation under text-only supervision
text: Carries out a high-energy theory calculation resumming the Sudakov shoulder in the C-parameter, producing derivations, simulation code, figures and a LaTeX paper in about two weeks.

title: Nine-loop scattering amplitude
text: Computes the nine-loop six-particle scattering amplitude in planar N=4 super-Yang-Mills using a Python and SymPy bootstrap, with the result independently validated by a leading physicist.

title: Predicting NMR spectra for new compounds
text: Predicts proton and carbon NMR peak positions and splitting for 20 novel compounds from preprints, then compares accuracy against ChemDraw and MestReNova.

title: Structure elucidation from NMR spectra
text: Proposes up to three ranked candidate structures from a molecular formula plus proton and carbon spectra, solving all eight simpler problems on every attempt.

title: Expert bioinformatics puzzles from real datasets
text: Answers 99 expert-written bioinformatics questions built from real datasets, such as inferring a single-cell sample's source organ, by installing tools and downloading reference genomes itself.

title: Proof of the dying percolation conjecture
text: Proves the dying percolation conjecture, open for over 60 years, by establishing the weakest inequality in a conjectured family, then formalizes the proof in Lean.

title: Tariff risk disclosures from 10-K filings
text: Extracts risk-factor sections from firms' 10-K filings on EDGAR into a DuckDB database, showing tariff-related risk disclosures growing more frequent and specific.

title: County-level mortgage lender panel
text: Builds a county-level panel from mortgage disclosure data to study lender concentration, then classifies lenders to show the rising share of fintech and non-bank mortgages.

title: Post-IPO performance replication via commits
text: Replicates a well-known study of post-IPO stock performance as a chain of version-controlled commits, each reviewed one change at a time.

title: Manuscript figures linked to analysis code
text: Links a research repository to a manuscript editor through GitHub so figures and tables update directly from code, keeping every number in the draft traceable.

title: Electrokinetics paper on particle shape
text: Works through the mathematics of how a charged particle's shape affects its motion in an electric field across five sessions, producing figures and drafting much of the paper.

title: Skill library for bioinformatics benchmark
text: Packages 196 structured Markdown files spanning genomics, drug discovery and biostatistics as on-disk skills, lifting a bioinformatics benchmark score from 65 to 92 percent.

title: Analyzing 55 years of UN speeches
text: Translates natural-language questions about UN General Assembly speeches since 1946 into SQL, builds quotation tables, and checks samples to study sovereignty, rearmament and two-state-solution discourse.

title: Research grant application draft
text: Drafts a research grant application from past applications, the funder's template and internal research data, adding academic citations and downloading the cited papers for the author to verify.

title: Professor's two decades of research as a game
text: Turns twenty years of a professor's technology-transitions research into a one-button browser game, iterating over 90 rounds so each element traces back to the published work.

title: Layered climate physics visualizer
text: Builds a 3D browser climate simulator that adds physics layer by layer to explain one city's odd seasons, checking the output against observations while guarding against overfitting.

title: Global atmosphere simulation on the GPU
text: Builds a hydrostatic global atmosphere simulation on a hexagonal grid with moist convection, sea ice, snow and a two-layer ocean, running on the GPU in a browser, in one weekend.

title: Idea-to-paper pipeline for computational research
text: Takes a research idea, checks its novelty, writes experiment code, runs it on cloud GPUs and drafts the paper, with a few minutes of human time per project.

title: Academic skills inside a notes app
text: Embeds a coding sidebar in a note-taking app with commands that review manuscripts, verify citations against CrossRef and OpenAlex, find literature gaps and suggest journals.

title: Variant interpretation workspace for genomics teams
text: Carries genomic variants from raw data to interpretation in one workspace, cross-referencing ClinVar, gnomAD frequencies and ACMG guidelines for rare-disease and clinical genomics teams.

title: Guardrailed workflow for research data analysis
text: Wraps a coding workflow in strict guardrails and best-practice checks so skilled researchers can scale data analysis while keeping transparency, rigor and reproducibility.

title: On-demand skills for scientific tools
text: Generates a reusable skill for any named scientific tool on request, such as CellRanger, and has already produced 176 covering genomics, molecular simulation and imaging.

title: Choosing the right gene isoform for mRNA screening
text: Automates picking the correct gene isoform for mRNA therapeutic drug screening, a manual step that can leave a candidate targeting the wrong tissue or a non-functional protein.

title: Color-naming psychophysics web test
text: Builds a browser color-naming test with randomized order and fields for first language and colorblindness, collecting responses from tens of thousands of visitors for vision-science analysis.

title: Sequencing own DNA at home
text: Guides a first-time lab novice through extracting DNA and sequencing a personal genome on a nanopore sequencer to about 16x coverage, validated against 600,000 consumer-test SNPs.

title: Reviewable patches for LaTeX papers
text: Reads a paper's .tex and .bib files and generates reviewable diff patches fixing venue formatting, citation problems, leftover TODO markers and anonymization before conference submission.

title: Days of exploration on a new idea
text: Spends several days plotting and prototyping data for a new scientific idea to judge whether the idea is worth pursuing.

title: Interactive map from 19th-century mail tables
text: Builds a single-file interactive map and table of historical mail transit times from about 8,000 transcribed records, linking hover highlights, adding railroad-line data, and flagging likely transcription errors.

title: Formalizing Sendov's conjecture in Lean
text: Builds a Lean 4 formalization of Sendov's conjecture over four days, from a finite-range numerical inequality through the analytic reduction chain, producing certificate generators, audit scripts and commits.

title: Porting edgeR to pure Python
text: Ports a differential-expression package of about 14,800 lines of R and C to pure Python with an AnnData interface and Numba for speed, after a smaller port reproduced results exactly.

title: Consolidating 2,859 research files
text: Converts thousands of scattered docx, hwp and PDF research files and hundreds of notes to markdown, organizes them into quality tiers, and sets up a dissertation workspace in about a day and a half.

title: Combustion solver migrated from Fortran to Python
text: Migrates a 36,800-line Fortran combustion solver to Python over 38 days and builds a pipeline that reproduces published papers, validating 40 of them against Cantera with 5.5 percent mean error.

title: TESS transit search with vetting
text: Searches public NASA TESS light curves for transiting planets, vets each candidate against catalogs of known objects, and writes a self-contained HTML report, yielding four candidate-planet research notes.

title: Months-long math research workspace
text: Structures a months-long mathematical research project with a workspace and session-continuity workflow so a physicist or mathematician spends less time on housekeeping and repeated mistakes.

title: Theoretical physics research workspace
text: Scaffolds a theoretical physics workspace where a written problem triggers a literature survey, a plan, derivations dispatched to fresh sub-agents, result reviews, and a synthesized answer, committing after every step.

title: Verbatim BibTeX from NASA ADS
text: Searches NASA ADS by author, title or arXiv ID and appends verbatim BibTeX entries to a paper's .bib file with duplicate detection, avoiding invented citations in astronomy papers and proposals.

title: Climate science review toolkit
text: Packages skills and domain-expert reviewer routines for scientific computing in climate research, built and used by an atmospheric scientist who holds a PhD.

title: Amazon tipping-cascade research by an independent
text: Builds computational simulations of Amazon moisture recycling to test whether deforestation creates a one-way valve where forest loss gets easier and recovery harder, as independent research.

title: Plant names linked to published chemistry
text: Resolves a plant name's validity, collection records and already-published chemistry across GBIF, WCVP and LOTUS, to answer which plant a mass spectrum came from.

title: Audited genotype-array report
text: Turns a 23andMe-style export of about 600,000 variants into an audited, reproducible bilingual single-file HTML report, with a separate pipeline for 30x whole-genome FASTQ and BAM input.

title: Local VCF analysis with confidence tiers
text: Analyzes DNA and VCF files locally and separates stronger signals, weaker signals, and findings a genome cannot reliably support.

title: Journal-ready analytical chemistry figures
text: Produces journal-ready calibration curves with LOD and LOQ bands, calculated PXRD patterns from CIF files and PLS diagnostics from spectra, each with a script that reproduces the figure.

title: Biology ideas as sourced interactive figures
text: Turns a biology idea such as dopamine receptors and the addiction circuit into an interactive, cited, isometric figure.

title: Reproducing and auditing paper repositories
text: Statically audits research papers and their companion GitHub repositories for reproducibility problems across applied machine learning, data science and computational biology.

title: Editable chemical structures from paper figures
text: Draws editable ChemDraw chemical structures and rebuilds structure figures from papers, so molecules need not be redrawn by hand.

title: PhD workflow for reproducing papers
text: Supports a PhD workflow of reproducing papers, designing experiments, reviewing manuscripts and comparing results with a set of research skills.

title: Planning and reviewing nf-core pipelines
text: Plans, runs and reviews Nextflow and nf-core bioinformatics workflows from a terminal session, checking each step of the pipeline before results are accepted.

title: Microscope settings from a research goal
text: Turns a research goal into microscope settings, checks them against what the instrument can physically do, and reviews each plan through eight lenses before running it.

title: Geoscience skills for seismic and well-log work
text: Handles geoscience workflows including seismic processing, well-log interpretation, three-dimensional modelling, inversion and geostatistics through a set of 30 skills.

title: Ocean state estimate analysis
text: Analyzes the ECCO v4r4 ocean state estimate and SWOT sea-surface-height data, including meridional transport and budget closure, for physical oceanography work.

title: Protein design campaign skills
text: Runs protein design workflows end to end, from target selection through binder design to ranking candidates for wet-lab testing.

title: Flu hospitalization quantile forecaster
text: Forecasts weekly influenza hospitalizations as quantiles for the CDC FluSight challenge, scoring against a baseline replica using only data available at the time and showing a live dashboard.

title: Auditing quantum computing research claims
text: Audits quantum-computing papers with a chain of checks and a taxonomy of quantum-CS fallacies, tracking token and dollar cost of each review.

title: Dual-channel live microscopy analysis
text: Guides calibrated dual-channel live-cell microscopy and descriptive image analysis, giving bilingual instructions to researchers using the technique.

title: Source-traced scientific paper writing
text: Writes scientific papers with source-traced review, ensuring each claim links to evidence, and rewrites passages to remove machine-sounding prose.

title: Reference tree planning for protein queries
text: Resolves protein queries, selects reference sequences, and plans reproducible phylogenetic trees with an auditable record of each choice.

title: Cosmological Bayesian analysis helper
text: Guides cosmologists through the Cobaya Bayesian-analysis framework and the class_sz pipeline for thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich power spectra, halo calculations and likelihood setup.
